remarks: Location! Location! Location!!! Mid-City living at its best! SPACIOUS & BRIGHT unit in quiet COMPLEX. Walking distance to beautiful MILL RIVER PARK. Good size 2 bedrooms (perfect to work from the home) Primary Bedroom with walk in closet. Newer Washer, Dryer & Hot water Heater. Laundry in the unit. OPEN LAYOUT provides comfortable living. Unit has 1 assigned parking space in garage and one assigned space in front. COMPLEX is Conveniently located near I-95, shopping, schools, library, parks, skating and houses of worship. Walking distance to Downtown, & Stamford Train Station. Easy commute to NEW YORK. Tenant pays all the utilities. PHOTOS are before renting the unit. Unit is rented now. Lease can be stared from April, 2026
